How it works

Set it up once. Then answer only the texts that matter.

  1. Pick a plan

    Month-to-month, or a lower price with a 12-month agreement. Your first month is charged at checkout. No setup fee.

  2. Set up together

    On a setup call we add your homes, tenants, vendors, house rules and your own lease with you.

  3. Tenants get one welcome text

    It explains KeyHelm and how to stop texts. From then on, tenants text one number for repairs and questions, day or night.

  4. You approve by text

    Big repairs, applicants, renewals and deposits come to you with a short code. Reply YES or NO and KeyHelm takes it from there.

Questions

Before you switch

Does KeyHelm touch my rent money?

Never. Tenants pay you directly, the same way they do today. KeyHelm sends reminders, asks you "Did rent arrive?" before calling anything late, and lets you decide on a late fee. At move-out it prepares the deposit statement, and you send the refund.

You choose how tenants pay you. Colorado requires a free way to pay rent, so make sure one of your options is free.

How does KeyHelm handle fair housing?

The assistant shares facts about the home itself, like price, size, pets and availability. It never discusses neighborhoods, safety, schools or who a home is "good for", and it never scores, ranks or recommends applicants.

Accommodation requests, complaints and legal questions go straight to you. Every applicant's report is shown next to the same written criteria, and you make every decision.

What happens in an emergency at 2 AM?

KeyHelm replies right away and texts you. For a flood or no heat, it walks the tenant through safe steps like the water shut-off and contacts the emergency vendor on your list (24/7 emergency dispatch is part of Autopilot Pro).

If anyone may be in danger, like a gas smell, fire, smoke or carbon monoxide, it tells them to call 911 first. KeyHelm is not an emergency service and doesn't replace 911.

What about my data and my tenants' privacy?

We don't sell personal information. This website has no ads and no advertising trackers. Mobile numbers and texting consent are never shared with third parties or affiliates for marketing.

You own your data and can ask for a copy or for deletion at any time. Read the Privacy policy and how our texts work.

Are Colorado rules built in?

Yes. KeyHelm's reminders and notices follow Colorado rules: no late fee until rent is 7 days late, capped at the greater of $50 or 5% of past-due rent; one rent increase per 12 months; repair start times (24 hours for health and safety, 72 hours otherwise); deposit statements within 30 days; a for-cause reason and 90 days' notice to not renew; and one all-in rent in listings.

They're reminders, not legal advice. You stay the landlord.

How do I cancel?

Month-to-month plans cancel anytime. Email us from your account email and you won't be charged again; it takes effect at the end of the month you've paid for.

A 12-month agreement is billed monthly for 12 months. Details are in the Refund and cancellation policy and Terms.

What do my tenants see?

One welcome text that explains KeyHelm and how to stop texts. After that they text one number for repairs and questions, and replies say they're automated. They keep paying you the same way.

Does anyone come to my property?

No. KeyHelm is software. Showings are self-guided through a lock you control, or you show the home yourself. Repairs go to your own vendors.

Can I use my own lease?

Yes. Upload it once. KeyHelm fills in each new tenant's names, dates, rent and deposit and sends it for e-signature. Your wording stays yours.

I already have a property manager. How do I switch?

Check your current agreement for its notice period first. On your setup call we'll go through what to collect from your manager, like tenant contact details, leases and deposit records, and set up your homes in KeyHelm.
